violation_type.title: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly (26 TAC §746.3407(10))
violation_type.short_title: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly
violation_type.typical_finding: During the inspection, certain areas of the center exhibited low temperatures. Two thermostats indicated readings of 60 degrees and 64 degrees, while the external temperature was recorded at below 40 degrees.

finding_variants.text: During the inspection, certain areas of the center exhibited low temperatures. Two thermostats indicated readings of 60 degrees and 64 degrees, while the external temperature was recorded at below 40 degrees.
During a follow up inspection, multiple classrooms felt warm during the walkthrough of the operation.
When conducting a walkthrough of the facility it was observed that the AC was off and it was 79 degrees inside the operation.
The air vent in the main care room had dark colored debris visible at the opening and a strong odor of mildew coming from it.
The illumination within the initial classroom appears to be malfunctioning and requires immediate attention.
During the inspection, classrooms were cold and the thermostat read 62 degrees in one room and 57 degrees in another room.

occurrences.finding: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly: This standard was tasked to be reviewed as part of an investigation and is found to be deficient.

Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly: Recited:  Temperature measurements taken in three classrooms during the follow up inspection were lower than the city mandated lowest temperature allowed for child care facilities.

Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly: During the inspection, certain areas of the center exhibited low temperatures. Two thermostats indicated readings of 60 degrees and 64 degrees, while the external temperature was recorded at below 40 degrees.

Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly: Based on evidence collected during this investigation, it was determined that the operation failed to ensure that the infant classroom was warm enough for infants in care.  The classroom was observed to be very cold, with temperatures measured as low as 64.6⁰ F.  Other classrooms measured within a degree of two of this temperature, and one classroom that was not in use at the time measured at 56.5⁰ F.
Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly: During the inspection, classrooms were cold and the thermostat read 62 degrees in one room and 57 degrees in another room.
Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly: The center is not being well heated.

Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly: Observed two classrooms to be warm and damp with no proper ventilation. Window AC units observed in area but did not provide suficient AC to keep building cool and properly ventilated.

The thermostat inside the school age room and where the children eat read 81 degrees and the thermostat inside the preschool room read 82 degrees.
